label: أحمد — فصحى
ref_text: لَا يَمُرُّ يَوْمٌ إِلَّا وَأَسْتَقْبِلُ عِدَّةَ رَسَائِلَ، تَتَضَمَّنُ أَسْئِلَةً مُلِحَّةْ.
notes: MSA male reference clip from the Arabic-TTS-Spark repo; transcript is the demo Space's default reference text (fully diacritized). No model here trained on it. The omnivoice_najdi model keeps little of its timbre (similarity 0.46) and speaks it with a Saudi accent; for MSA in this voice use omnivoice_base.
